settings.label: Open Drawings With
settings.description: Writer opens .excalidraw.md and .excalidraw files itself. Choose the Obsidian plugin to hand them back to it (needs the plugin on).

settings.label: Keep an SVG Next to Each Drawing
settings.description: Write <name>.svg beside a drawing after every save and every change from outside (an agent, sync). Needs the drawing's window open.
